SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.102

Report category on Enter bill (bills, credits and item receipts), as on the other forms. It’s for the Treasurer’s report and isn’t sent to QuickBooks.
Club payables by report category: while a bill is unpaid, it shows in the Treasurer’s report payables under its category, with a heading, its vendors and bills, and a subtotal. Bills without one come last under Other payables. This applies on screen, in Excel and in the PDF.
Where a bill’s category comes from: the one chosen in the report’s new Unpaid bills (payables) list, which also covers bills entered straight in QuickBooks; else the one on the bill; else the category whose default accounts include the bill’s expense account.
